full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white long-exposure photograph shows a seated figure in flowing pale fabric before a fan of fine radiating light trails. The scene is a dark open ground beneath a broad gray night sky, with a low nearly level horizon crossing behind the figure. At the center, the person is seen in left-facing profile, seated upright with bent legs and hands near the lap. The head, shoulders, and torso appear as a dark silhouette because a bright white glow rises directly behind them. A long translucent skirt or veil spreads from the body across the lower left and right, its folds catching light along thin edges while the central cloth remains gray. The surrounding ground is coarse and irregular, with small pale flecks visible near the horizon and deep black patches in the foreground. Above the seated form, dozens of narrow white lines sweep outward and upward through the gray sky. Some arcs begin near the bright central area; others cross diagonally from the upper corners, forming a loose luminous web rather than a single solid beam. The brightest light gathers just behind the shoulders and along the horizontal band at ground level, then fades quickly into the darker upper and lower edges. The figure has no legible facial detail, and no other person or readable text appears. The viewpoint is low and frontal to the open setting, giving the small silhouette a quiet central presence. Long exposure softens the fabric and glow, while the moving light traces remain thin and energetic. The grayscale stays restrained, from silver-white highlights to smoky midtones and dense black. The overall composition is still at its center but animated by the surrounding lines, balancing a calm human form against a wide field of luminous motion.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白长曝光摄影呈现一名身披流动浅色布料的坐姿人物，身后是细密放射光迹扇形展开。场景为宽阔灰色夜空下的暗色开阔地，一条低而近乎水平的地平线从人物身后穿过。中央人物以朝左侧的侧面出现，挺身坐着，双腿弯曲，双手靠近腿部。头、肩和躯干成为深色剪影，因为明亮白光正从背后升起。一条长而半透明的裙摆或薄纱从身体向左下和右下铺散，褶皱细边接住光，中央布面则保持灰色。周围地面粗糙不平，地平线附近可见细小浅色点，前景则有深黑色斑块。坐姿形体上方，数十道窄白线向外向上划过灰色天空。有些弧线始于中央亮区附近，另一些从上方角落斜向交叉，形成松散发亮的线网，而非单一坚实光束。最亮光聚在肩后与地面水平亮带，随后迅速衰减到较暗的上下边缘。人物没有可辨脸部细节，也没有其他人或可读文字。视点低而正对开阔环境，让小剪影在中央安静地存在。长曝光柔化布料和辉光，移动光迹却保持细而有活力。灰阶克制，从银白高光经烟灰中间调到浓黑。整体构图中央静止，周围线条却充满运动，以安静的人体形状平衡宽阔的发光动态场。
style_prompt_en: The long-exposure photographic style combines a nearly black low ground with a broad smoky midtone field and fine high-value light traces. Brightness pools around a compact central area, then radiates as many hairline arcs across the surrounding space. Soft translucent layers catch narrow rim highlights, while darker forms remain nearly featureless silhouettes. A low horizontal division stabilizes the otherwise restless diagonal lines. Strong backlighting creates a luminous halo and quick falloff into charcoal, keeping attention on the interaction between still mass and energetic trace. Grain, soft glow, and slightly blurred edges preserve a photographic feel even where the light becomes abstract. The overall effect is meditative and uncanny, with motion recorded as delicate structure around a quiet center.
style_prompt_zh: 这种长曝光摄影风格将近黑色低处地面、宽阔烟灰中间调区域与细亮光迹组合。亮度聚在紧凑中央，再化作许多发丝般弧线向周围辐射。柔软半透明层接住狭窄轮廓亮边，较暗形体保持近乎无细节的剪影。一条低位水平分割稳住原本躁动的斜线。强背光制造发光光晕并迅速衰减至炭色，使注意力集中在静止大形与活跃痕迹的相互作用。颗粒、柔光和略微模糊的边缘，即使在光线变得抽象时也保留摄影感。整体效果冥想般安静而奇异，运动被记录成围绕平静中心的精细结构。
theme_en: A seated silhouette in flowing white fabric before radiating light trails
theme_zh: 放射光迹前，身披白色长布的坐姿剪影
name: Light field photography
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
